notes.semetey-1-2013:p0139:b005:l015: Narrator describes Bakay calling toward the cave where Kanykey had sheltered. He fears the widow and orphan were killed, then praises her character, courage and holiness; not a hostile moral epithet. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
